name: 02155 · Medford, MA
findings: ZIP 02155 (Medford) has 205 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 69 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02155 (Medford) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02155 (Medford) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 59 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
